# Ayming Belgium

> Ayming Belgium is a consulting firm specializing in innovation financing, tax optimization, and HR services for Belgian businesses.

Ayming Belgium serves as a comprehensive advisory partner for companies seeking to maximize R&D funding, navigate tax incentives (DRI, DMR, PP), and optimize HR and payroll operations. The firm combines expertise in European funding programs (Horizon Europe, EIC Accelerator) with deep knowledge of Belgian tax and labor law.

## Key Topics

- Innovation Financing
- Tax Incentives (DRI, DMR, PP)
- Horizon Europe
- EIC Accelerator
- HR Compliance
- Payroll Management
- Tax Optimization
- R&D Funding
- Digital Transformation
- Salary Incentives
- Compliance & Audits
- Real Estate Tax
- Industrial Tax Optimization
- Belgium Labor Law
- Business Growth

## Innovation Financing

- [Financement de l'innovation](https://www.ayming.be/innovation): Innovation financing services covering tax incentives and R&D funding
- [Financement direct de l'innovation](https://www.ayming.be/innovation/financement-direct-de-linnovation): Direct innovation financing via Horizon Europe and EIC Accelerator programs
- [Incitations fiscales à l'innovation](https://www.ayming.be/innovation/incitations-fiscales-a-linnovation): Belgian tax incentives for innovation: DRI, DMR, and PP deductions

## Tax Strategy & Optimization

- [Fiscalité](https://www.ayming.be/fiscalite): Tax strategy and fiscal optimization services for Belgian businesses
- [Optimisation de la fiscalité immobilière](https://www.ayming.be/fiscalite/optimisation-de-la-fiscalite-immobiliere): Real estate tax optimization and property portfolio management services
- [Optimisation fiscale industrielle](https://www.ayming.be/fiscalite/optimisation-fiscale-industrielle): Industrial tax optimization with capex deductions and asset audits

## Human Resources & Payroll

- [Ressources humaines](https://www.ayming.be/rh): HR services: payroll management, cost control, talent retention, compliance
- [Suivi des incitations salariales](https://www.ayming.be/rh/suivi-des-incitations-salariales): Salary incentives tracking and payroll optimization with tax exemptions
- [Services RH sur mesure](https://www.ayming.be/rh/services-rh-sur-mesure): Custom HR services aligned with Belgian labor law and compliance
- [Monitoring continu](https://www.ayming.be/rh/monitoring-continu): Continuous payroll monitoring and salary incentives compliance tracking
- [Assistance au contrôle social et fiscal](https://www.ayming.be/rh/assistance-au-controle-social-et-fiscal): Social and fiscal audit assistance with compliance and risk assessment

## Industry Solutions

- [Industrie](https://www.ayming.be/secteurs/industrie): Innovation consulting for manufacturing: automation, clean tech, digitalization
- [Technologie et digital](https://www.ayming.be/secteurs/technologie-et-digital): Tech and digital innovation funding for AI, software, 5G, IoT solutions
- [Santé et pharma](https://www.ayming.be/secteurs/sante-et-pharma): Healthcare and pharma R&D financing for biotech and medical devices
- [Services financiers](https://www.ayming.be/secteurs/financier): Financial services expertise for banking, insurance, fintech innovation
- [Agroalimentaire](https://www.ayming.be/secteurs/agroalimentaire): Agrifood financing for innovation, automation, and sustainable production
